summary: The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate to save costs and reduce funding for broadband infrastructure. Brief The text presents a comprehensive review of epidemiological studies on the potential health effects of exposure to electromagnetic fields (EMFs) generated by power lines, particularly focusing on the impact of magnetic fields on melatonin production and its association with increased risk of childhood leukemia.
